decisions.statement: A world answers the paths under a folder from the tree rather than from the index.
A path an answer writes under a folder is among the paths that folder answers.
A path an answer takes away is left out of the paths that folder answers.
A folder a page claims is left out of the paths a folder answers.
Every file that folder has is left out with the folder.
A folder left out holding no file is left out of that answer too.
A world answers which files git tracks under a folder and holds on disk, with the answer laid over.
A repository git will not answer for answers nothing rather than no file.
No folder outside the checkout is read.
A page the answer writes claims the files that page names.
A page the answer takes away claims no file.
A folder the answer writes a file under is among the folders left out.
A folder the answer takes every file away from holds no file for that answer.
A path the answer writes is among those files though git tracks that path nowhere.
A path the answer takes away is left out of those files though git tracks that path.
The root folder answers those files rather than answering nothing.
A file the tree holds that git ignores is among those files where its name says uncommitted.
A file git tracks that the tree no longer holds is left out of those files.
A caller asking whether a path names a file or a folder is answered from the tree.
A path the tree holds names something whether or not the index has that path.
A path the answer writes names something though the tree holds that path nowhere.
A path the answer takes away names nothing though the tree holds that path.
A folder above a path the answer writes names something too.
A path spelled outside the checkout names nothing.

definition: the paths under a folder, read from the tree rather than from the index
